scope: Eight source-read workflows demonstrating issue admission, issue intake, workflow handoff, mentions, slash commands, manual dispatch, typed repository events, and path-filtered push automation. The workflow directory contains 332 YAML files while the generated catalog contains 331; project-repository-visibility.yml is absent from that catalog snapshot.

records.selector: Template matching by declared labels or title prefix in scripts/ops/swarm_admission.py
records.gate: issue-dispatch/v1 template match + QUE tier → after → chain → flow projection

records.selector: issue has project-task label OR title starts [task] OR body contains ### Task / spec
records.gate: intake parser; only valid parse proceeds to dispatch queue
records.effect: routing receipt + dispatch-queued or intake diagnosis + intake-incomplete

records.selector: admission handoff artifact identifies game-development-task and decision admitted
records.gate: upstream conclusion success + handoff artifact validation + task parser
records.effect: queueing comment and game-development/dispatch-queued labels on valid filing

records.selector: Label jules/Jules/JULES; or comment body starts @jules/@Jules from User with OWNER/MEMBER/COLLABORATOR association on non-PR issue
records.gate: label path has trusted-actor verification; mention path has trusted association and user/non-PR context
records.effect: label path invokes Jules API or fallback; mention path reacts and coordinates existing agent PRs before invocation

records.selector: manual dispatch OR comment starts @gemini-cli /build from OWNER/MEMBER/COLLABORATOR
records.effect: build receipt and PR or failure receipt

records.selector: explicit provider-command event or operator-supplied manual inputs
records.gate: allowlisted provider/action, PR/head SHA and policy validations
records.effect: provider command receipt on PR and dispatch stamp fan-out

records.selector: comment body contains <!-- request-delphi-intake --> OR manual dispatch
records.gate: intake job condition and form/input validation
records.effect: Delphi RFP intake receipt and finished intake record

records.selector: Push to master touching the versioned owner request file
records.gate: Authenticated owner identity + admin permission + exact target repository/name/id + explicit public visibility request + post-patch readback
records.effect: Changes allowlisted product repository visibility to public and writes a non-secret workflow summary receipt
records.notes: Source configuration includes an explicit owner-authored request file and runtime identity/permission checks; the census records configured behavior, not a run result.
